freeze_rule: R0, both authority paths, their validity/scope/effective intervals, exact proposition/scope/consequence, conflicting dispositions, source facts and rules remain fixed. Only the presence versus absence of a prospectively constituted governing precedence relation may differ across the pair, plus specimen/packet identity.
no_answer_smuggling_rule: No winner, priority, override, selected authority, precedence result, case-specific disposition, order-derived proxy, or precomputed constitutional answer may be supplied to the Pack input.
hard_rules: Concurrent validity does not create precedence. Precedence must itself be constituted.
Where no governing precedence relation exists, the Pack must not manufacture one from execution order or implementation convenience.
